identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of GC101 TIL in Advanced Melanoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Controlled,Open Label, Phase II Trial of Autologous Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocytes (GC101 TIL) in Subjects With Advanced Melanoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: 98 participants will be randomly assigned 1:1 to the experimental group and the control group for the Phase II clinical trial，this trail is expected to be finished in 24 months
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This study is to investigate the efficacy and safety of autologous tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (GC101 TIL) therapy versus investigator's choice of chemotherapy in patients with advanced melanoma. Autologous TILs are expanded from tumor resections or biopsies and infused i.v. into the patient after NMA lymphodepletion treatment with cyclophosphamide and hydroxychloroquine.

armGroups.label: GC101 TIL group
armGroups.description: A tumor sample is resected from each participant and cultured ex vivo to expand the population of autologous tumor infiltrating lymphocytes injection (GC101 TIL). After lymphodepletion, patients are infused GC101 TIL followed sintilimab.

armGroups.label: Investigator's choice of chemotherapy
armGroups.description: monotherapy or combination of dacarbazine, temozolomide, paclitaxel,carboplatin or cisplatin, and the chemotherapy's dosage could refer to the drug label or the relevant treatment guideline, the final decision is up to investigator.
interventionNames: Drug: dacarbazine, temozolomide, paclitaxel ,platinum or cisplatin

interventions.name: GC101 TIL
interventions.description: Patients with advanced melanoma (excluding uveal melanoma) who have failed to PD-1 antibodies (if BRAF mutation is present, BRAF and MEK inhibitors have failed; if NRAS mutation is present, tunlametinib have failed) and are ineligible for resection

interventions.name: dacarbazine, temozolomide, paclitaxel ,platinum or cisplatin
interventions.description: monotherapy or combination of dacarbazine, temozolomide, paclitaxel, platinum or cisplatun, and the chemotherapy's dosage could refer to the drug label or the relevant treatment guideline, the final decision is up to investigator

primaryOutcomes.description: Progression-free survival (PFS) confirmed by the Independent Review Committee (IRC) according to RECIST 1.1

secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall survival (OS) and OS rates at 6, 12, and 18 months
PFS assessed by investigators according to RECIST 1.1 and PFS assessed by IRC and investigators according to iRECIST
Objective Response Rate (ORR) assessed by IRC and investigators according to RECIST 1.1 and iRECIST
Disease Control Rates (DCR) assessed by IRC and investigators according to RECIST 1.1 and iRECIST
Duration of Response (DoR) assessed by IRC and investigators according to RECIST 1.1 and iRECIST
